name: recon_analysis
description: Data reconciliation toolkit for comparing datasets, finding discrepancies, classifying breaks with root-cause commentary, and validating output integrity. Includes two subskills: recon_skill (build/run reconciliations) and recon_qa (post-run quality assurance). Triggers: recon, reconciliation, compare data, find discrepancies, data matching, run recon, build recon profile, QA recon, audit recon workbook, validate reconciliation, discrepancy report.
